project.name: PEX
project.summary: PEX watches coding agents, verifies progress against persistent goals, and intervenes only when evidence justifies it.
project.ai_usage: Strands Agents evaluates bounded local evidence and returns validated NOOP or same-session intervention decisions; local verification and policy remain authoritative.
project.codex_usage: Codex helped audit the three binding specifications, repair and test the product, build release candidates, and produce evidence-grounded submission material.
